html:
Drywall Contractor Atlanta

Need drywall work in Atlanta? Build Heritage is a licensed and insured contractor that delivers drywall services for homes and other residential projects in metro Atlanta and surrounding Georgia.

How a drywall project starts with us

  1. Request a free quote – fill out the online form or email info@buildheritage.org.
  2. We reply within one business day with a written, itemized estimate.
  3. Schedule the work – we set a date that fits your schedule.
  4. Professional drywall work – our crew installs or repairs drywall, then finishes with tape, mud, and sanding.
  5. Final inspection – we ensure the surface is smooth and ready for paint or trim.

What you get and costs

  • Eight trades available, including drywall, painting, flooring & vinyl, framing, doors, window & door trim, roofing & tiles, and packing & moving.
  • Free, written, itemized quotes.
  • Response within one business day.
  • Cost guide (August 2026): drywall installation or repair typically falls within the $3,000‑$8,000 range for whole‑home interior repaint projects; keep an extra 10‑15 % on top of the quote for hidden issues.
  • Licensed and insured in Georgia.

FAQ

Do you serve the entire Atlanta metro area? Yes. We work in Atlanta, Marietta, Alpharetta, Roswell, Sandy Springs, Johns Creek, Duluth, Lawrenceville, Decatur, Smyrna, Kennesaw, Woodstock, Cumming, Gainesville, Athens, Augusta, Macon, Savannah, and Columbus.

Can I get a quote online? Absolutely. Use our online form or visit the itemized contractor quote page.

What happens if hidden issues arise during the job? The cost guide recommends setting aside 10‑15 % of the quoted amount for any unforeseen problems that may surface during work.

Next Step

Ready to start your drywall project? Get a free quote today.
